dex.text: Milk white, with a mane the green of wet moss and bells that ring when nobody is near them. Folk who ride it are taken under the hill for seven years and come back unable to tell a lie. Politicians are advised to keep clear.
dex.fact: Thomas of Erceldoune, the Rhymer, lived near Melrose in the 1200s. The old ballad has the Queen of Elfland carry him off on a white horse hung with fifty-nine silver bells, and he returns with a tongue that can tell no lie.
